title: Green workflow must not promote a claim whose critical steps were skipped
failureDescription: The workflow and job concluded success while both publication-critical steps were skipped. The run supported VERIFIED_SETUP only, not PUBLICATION_COMPLETE.
mustNeverRepeat: Quote an overall green workflow as deployment, browser verification, publication, or user delivery evidence without checking the named claim manifest.
Count a preflight or evidence artifact as the outcome-bearing delivery.
Hide skipped claim-critical steps behind the workflow conclusion.
requiredEvidence: exact workflow run, job, and tested commit
actual step conclusions including skipped and missing

gateLogic.pass: All claim-required steps conclude success and all claim proof predicates match.
gateLogic.hold: Any claim-required step is skipped, missing, failed, or cancelled, or any proof predicate mismatches.
gateLogic.scopeBoundary: A skipped step is not globally fatal; it blocks only claims that declare that step critical.
gateLogic.workflowConclusion: Transport/execution metadata only; it never promotes the claim by itself.

appliesTo: Mother workflows that make outcome-bearing delivery claims
activationRequirement: Run once in an actual affected Mother workflow and obtain an independent verifier receipt before adoption.
